sentences.text: The appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on IA No.13500 of 2022, which is an application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the appellant-Halu @ Ajay for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

Appellant has been convicted under Section 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5(L)J(2)/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to 10 years R.I. with fine of Rs.1,000/- and 10 years R.I. with fine of Rs.1,000/- with usual default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the appellant contended that the appellant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the aforesaid offence.
During trial he was remained on bail and he did not misuse the liberty given to him.
Prosecutrix (PW-1) has turned hostile and she did not support the prosecution story.
Conviction of the appellant is based only upon the DNA report (Ex.P/28).
There is a strong case in favour of the appellant.
Final conclusion of appeal will take a long sufficient time.
Hence he prays for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence of the appellant till the final disposal of the appeal.

for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection by submitting that prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident and the case of the prosecution is well supported by the statement of the prosecution witnesses as well as the DNA and FSL report.

1 prosecutrix (PW-1) has completely turned hostile before the trial Court and she did not state anything against the present appellant, she categorically stated in her statement that appellant neither abducted her nor committed any rape upon her, during the trial appellant was remained on bail and he did not misuse the liberty given to him and that final conclusion of this appeal will take a long sufficient time, I deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant.

sentences.text: Accordingly, IA No.13500 of 2022 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant is hereby suspended till the final disposal o f this appeal and it is ordered that the appellant be released on bail on his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and upon furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.75,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 20.3.2023 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
